description: This file defines the DistributedSub interface which provides methods for managing pub-sub subscriptions and acknowledgements within a distributed system, including subscribing, unsubscribing, removing subscribers, and managing acknowledgment labels.

classes.name: DistributedSub
classes.description: An interface providing methods for distributed pub-sub subscription management, acknowledgment handling, and subscriber control within the Ditto framework.

methods.name: subscribeWithFilterAndAck
methods.description: Subscribes to a collection of topics with a local filter and waits for acknowledgment, returning a future with subscription result.

methods.name: subscribeWithAck
methods.description: Subscribes to a collection of topics and waits for acknowledgment, returning a future with subscription result.

methods.name: unsubscribeWithAck
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a collection of topics and waits for acknowledgment, returning a future with unsubscription result.

methods.name: subscribeWithoutAck
methods.description: Subscribes to topics without waiting for acknowledgment.

methods.name: unsubscribeWithoutAck
methods.description: Unsubscribes from topics without waiting for acknowledgment.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber without waiting for acknowledgment.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declares acknowledgment labels for a subscriber, returning a future acknowledgment result.

methods.name: removeAcknowledgementLabelDeclaration
methods.description: Removes acknowledgment label declarations for a subscriber.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DistributedSub given a distributed data configuration and a sub-supervisor actor.
